integrity: Mathematical proof with directly replayed finite cases; scientific assessment is same-model only. The construction adapts the alternating-block model from arXiv:2609.24006v1, Lemma 7, rather than claiming that geometry as new.
scientific_limitations: ZFC; two possibly nonserial transitive-Euclidean relations; believed updates filter targets, not worlds; no claim for KD45/S5; infinite-ordinal proof is symbolic and finite program only tests ranks 0–8; older equivalent rank-theoretic formulation cannot be entirely excluded.
title: Exact ordinal spectrum for an atom-free two-agent belief update
